entries.060523dd312a36cd: It sets out the medium- to long-term vision 'Becoming a growing company that supports a sustainable society with specialty products and services' (goal for fiscal 2034), and positions the 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2027' from April 2025 to March 2028 as a period to work on proactive capital investment and restructuring of its business structure. In the domestic food business, it advances development and fostering of market-creating products, strengthening of proposals to the ready-made meal and instant meal markets, and proposals leading to food loss reduction. In the domestic chemical products and other business, it deepens the domestic market by narrowing to fields of strength and makes proposals to Japanese companies expanding overseas. In the overseas business, it advances focused investment in its Malaysian subsidiary, a core plant, and reorganization of production lines in China, and makes upfront investment through building a new structure. It also sets out a shift to management conscious of the balance sheet and reduction of cross-shareholdings.
